name: loanboard
description: Section A of the Streamhub QA automation assessment: a loan dashboard and the Playwright + Cucumber suite around it.

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-node.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/check-node.js && node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && cross-env CUCUMBER_PUBLISH_QUIET=true start-server-and-test vite http://127.0.0.1:5173 test:cucumber
scripts.test:self-healing: node scripts/check-node.js && node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && cross-env CUCUMBER_PUBLISH_QUIET=true start-server-and-test vite http://127.0.0.1:5173 test:self-healing:cucumber
scripts.heal:poc: node scripts/check-node.js && node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && start-server-and-test vite http://127.0.0.1:5173 heal:poc:run
scripts.sql: node scripts/check-node.js && node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning sql/run-sql.mjs
